rationale: The agent verified the user by matching full name and ZIP to a single account before proceeding. It inspected the user profile and orders via read-only tools, identified the correct pending order with the Washington, DC address, and requested explicit confirmation before updating the shipping address to the default Charlotte address. For item changes, the agent retrieved product variants with tools, presented accurate options, captured the user’s specific selections, summarized the exact changes (including item IDs), and obtained explicit confirmation. When the user requested to use PayPal for any price difference, the agent updated the summary to reflect PayPal and again sought confirmation before executing the modification. The subsequent tool call correctly replaced the specified items and charged the price difference to the PayPal method on file. Final information stated was accurate and consistent with tool results, and all actions were on the authenticated user’s account. No unsupported claims, incorrect actions, or writes without confirmation were observed.
